expectedComments: Explain the AS-facing contract, selected inputs, exact observations, and the important ownership/boundary rule for: Adds this object to the GC root set. Removes this object from the GC root set. Adds or removes the transactional object flag. Writes config-backed properties to configuration files. Loads config-backed properties from configuration files. Appends the UObject text representation to a temporary or existing string. Loads an object by path or name, using Outer as the resolution context.
expectedObservations: Consume every non-void result and compare its exact semantic value. Observe receiver, object, collection, callback, diagnostic, or lifecycle state after each void call. Cover null/non-null and object identity where the environment can produce both.
inputs: Seeded receiver state, the exact mutation arguments, repeated-call behavior, and cleanup or restoration inputs where the operation owns resources.
testScope: void UObject.AddToRoot(); | void UObject.RemoveFromRoot(); | void UObject.SetTransactional(bool bTransactional); | void UObject.SaveConfig(); | void UObject.LoadConfig(); | Text.Append(Object); | UObject LoadObject(UObject Outer, const FString& Name);
